title: PLAID targets mid-January 2027 to resume KARTE after breach; data of ended-contract companies also affected
summary: PLAID suspended all KARTE services after unauthorized access on November 13. Its November 20 release says a vulnerability was exploited, 79,249 account emails and 45,816 contact records of its own were taken, and some data of 570 to 754 customer companies, by category, was affected. The affected set includes companies whose contracts had ended. PLAID targets a phased resumption in mid-January 2027, a target it says may change.
plain: PLAID says its customer-data service KARTE should return in phases around mid-January 2027, and that data of companies that had ended their contracts was also hit.
exec: KARTE stays suspended until a target of mid-January 2027; former customers' data is also affected.
action: KARTE customers, including former ones, should rotate integration credentials and await PLAID's detailed data, which it says goes to affected companies from November 24.
